title: Convergence of entropy-conservative summation-by-parts discretizations to smooth solutions of hyperbolic conservation laws
summary: Although entropy-based summation-by-parts (SBP) discretizations of hyperbolic conservation laws are widely used for their robustness and stability properties, there are very few results on their convergence. We extend a recent convergence analysis of Worku, Del Rey Fernández, and Zingg (2026, DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.2603.18369) in two ways.
